articles.summary: Schneider National, Inc. (NYSE: SNDR), a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, today announced participation in the following investment conference: 2026 Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference: Tuesday, September 15, 2026. Jim Filter, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Darrell Campbell, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will participate in a fireside chat and a series of investor discussions. The chat will begin at 4:05 p.m. (Pacific Time) / 6:05 p.m. (Central Time). A webcast for this event may be located on Schneider’s Investor Relations website ( www.investors.schneider.com ) and available for a limited time following the conference. articles.summary: Successful integration has retained customers, expanded capabilities and created new opportunities through Schneider's nationwide network and resources Schneider National, Inc. (NYSE: SNDR), a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, is celebrating the third anniversary of its acquisition of MM Transport Services , marking three years of continued growth, customer retention and operational success. Since joining Schneider in August 2023, MM has leveraged Schneider's scale, technology and nationwide footprint to expand capabilities while maintaining the service and relationships MM’s customers have trusted for decades. The acquisition demonstrates Schneider 's disciplined approach to integrating businesses into its portfolio of companies while preserving the strengths that made them successful.
